core_obligations: Work in the constructible topology: since the map is spectral it is continuous there, and by the compactness and Hausdorffness of the constructible topology the bijection is a homeomorphism in that topology (proof lines 4832-4837)

Show the image of a quasi-compact open is open: given a point specializing into that image, the lifting hypothesis gives a preimage specializing into the quasi-compact open, so the point lies in the image, and the image is constructible and stable under specialization hence open (proof lines 4838-4846)
The dual case: when specializations lift instead, the same argument shows that images of complements of quasi-compact opens are closed (proof lines 4847)
proof_roadmap: 由谱性，f 对可构造拓扑连续；可构造拓扑紧且 Hausdorff ⇒ 双射即在该拓扑下同胚。
取准紧开 U；f(U) 在 Y 中可构造；若 y 特殊化到 f(U) 中一点，由「一般化可提升」得 f^{-1}(y) 特殊化到 U 中一点 ⇒ y ∈ f(U) ⇒ f(U) 对特殊化稳定且可构造 ⇒ 开（由 characterize-closed-Noetherian 型判据）。
对偶情形（特殊化可提升）改为证明「准紧开的补集的像是闭集」。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a spectral bijection between spectral spaces which lifts generalizations, respectively specializations, is a homeomorphism (author lemma at source lines 4821-4830, label lemma-spectral-bijective). The proof (source lines 4832-4848) first gets a homeomorphism for the constructible topology, then shows that the image of a quasi-compact open is constructible and stable under specialization, hence open, and records the dual argument (proof lines 4832-4847). The specialization argument is the substance. H3.
